material_findings.title: New arXiv preprint proposes offline-verifiable preserved evidence bundles for multi-agent workflows
material_findings.summary: arXiv:2608.28542 proposes event-level preserved evidence bundles for cross-organization agent messaging, including sender authentication, authenticated log commitments, witness-backed checkpoints, append-only continuity, delegation-aware authorization evidence, and explicit signed receipt evidence when policy requires it. The authors report a prototype evaluation over 300 complete workflows and 1,200 valid bundles plus negative-evidence tests that rejected corrupted or policy-insufficient bundles. It is a preprint and should not be treated as established production assurance.
material_findings.recommended_action: Have the build/integrity lane review the full paper and any available prototype artifacts for license, reproducibility, cryptographic assumptions, evidence schema overlap, and whether its verifier-centered bundle model can strengthen source snapshots, integration-queue contributions, case evidence, and append-only agent handoffs without duplicating existing repository structures.
